products.name: Midnight Floral Crossbody

process.title: Pick your piece
process.body: Choose something from the shop, or send us a design you have in mind — a name, a flower, a colour you like.

process.title: We stitch it
process.body: Most pieces are made to order. Small things take a few days; a custom bag takes longer. You'll see it before it is posted.

process.title: It comes to you
process.body: We agree the price and the delivery over Messenger, then send it by courier.

about.heading: A small studio, a lot of thread.
about.lead: Cozy Stitches began with a needle, a box of coloured thread and a habit of stitching in the evenings. It is still one person at a table, working slowly, on purpose.
body: Most of what you see here is made after you ask for it. That means the piece you receive was not sitting in a stack waiting — it was cut, lined, embroidered and finished for you, which is why the small things take a few days rather than a few hours.

The thread does the talking. Bows in wine and rose on white cotton, lavender and marigold on black canvas, jamdani stars on indigo. Where a design allows it, we stitch a name or a date into the piece so it belongs to one person only.
Nothing here is machine-embroidered and nothing is mass-produced. Where two pieces are meant to match, they never match exactly. That is the honest signature of handwork, not a fault.

items.value: Handloom cotton, cotton canvas, reclaimed denim, felt
Cotton embroidery thread, mostly Anchor and DMC
Metal zips, sliders and tassel pulls
Bangladesh, by hand, in small batches

care.heading: Looking after it
items: Hand wash in cool water with a mild soap. Never bleach.
Do not wring or scrub the embroidery. Press the water out flat between two towels.
Dry in the shade, flat, so the colour holds.
Iron on the reverse, warm, working around the stitching rather than over it.
Keep bangles and earrings away from perfume, hairspray and long soaking.

about.markBody: The emblem is drawn in the same terms as the work itself. Half the heart is running stitch and half is one unbroken line; a threaded needle runs through the middle; a pair of scissors sits below it, and under that, a row of zigzag stitching. The name is above all of it, and the two materials are below.

contact.heading: Ordering, delivery and payment.
contact.lead: The quickest way is a message. Tell us the piece, and we'll reply with the price, the timing and the delivery charge for your area.

shipping.heading: Delivery
items: Inside Dhaka and outside Dhaka are both sent by courier.
Message us your full address and we will confirm the exact charge before anything is paid.
Made-to-order pieces are posted once they are finished, not before.
International delivery is possible — ask us for a rate before you order.

payments.heading: Payment
items: Payment is arranged over Messenger, before posting.
Mobile financial services and bank transfer are both usual.
Ask about cash on delivery inside Dhaka.
You will always be told the full amount — item plus delivery — before you pay.

custom.heading: Custom work
custom.body: Most of what we make can be changed: the colour of the thread, the flower, the size, a name stitched into the piece. Send a photo of what you have in mind and we'll tell you what it costs and how long it takes. A custom bag usually takes longer than a pouch, so plan ahead if it is a gift.

faq.q: How do I actually place an order?
faq.a: Pick a piece in the shop and tap an order button. A message opens with the item and its reference code already in it. Send that, and we'll confirm the price and the delivery charge.

faq.q: Why is there no price on the site?
faq.a: Because most pieces are made to order and the thread and size change the cost. Ask for any item and you'll have a firm price straight away.
A pouch or a bookmark is usually a few days. A bag, or anything with a name stitched into it, takes longer. We'll give you a date when you order and tell you if it slips.

faq.q: Can I get a name or a date stitched in?
faq.a: Yes, on most pieces. Send the exact spelling when you order — we'll show you the layout before we sew it.

faq.q: What if I don't like it when it arrives?
faq.a: Tell us. Made-to-order and personalised pieces can't be resold, so they can't be returned, but if something is wrong with the workmanship we will put it right.

faq.q: Do you take bulk or wholesale orders?
faq.a: For weddings, gifting and small shops, yes. Message us with the quantity, the design and the date you need it and we'll quote for it.

footer.note: Hand-embroidered in Bangladesh. Made to order, in small batches.
